title: First-Order Trajectory Matching: Fast Ensemble Predictions of Chaotic, Turbulent, Stochastic Systems
title_zh: First-Order Trajectory Matching：面向混沌、湍流与随机系统的快速集成预测
abstract_en: We introduce First-Order Trajectory Matching (FTM), a surrogate-modeling method that learns the first-order local transport of probability mass from trajectories of stochastic systems. By matching the symmetric first-order motion of trajectories, FTM learns the probability current velocity, whose flow preserves time marginals to match ensemble averages, while also capturing current-like trajectory quantities such as fluxes, circulations, and barrier-crossing currents. FTM learns the current velocity directly from trajectories, avoiding drift, diffusion, and score estimation. Our stability analysis separates discretization error from sampling variance and shows that the one-step simulation-free FTM loss is stable when temporal resolution and sample size are properly balanced. Across stochastic dynamical systems and PDE examples, we empirically demonstrate that FTM provides trajectory-aware ensemble predictions at low, deterministic-rollout cost.
abstract_zh: 本文提出 First-Order Trajectory Matching（FTM），一种从随机系统轨迹中学习概率质量一阶局部输运的代理建模方法。FTM 通过匹配轨迹的对称一阶运动来学习概率流速度（probability current velocity），其流能够保持时间边缘分布，从而匹配集成平均；同时还能捕捉通量、环流、越障电流等类似概率流的轨迹量。该方法直接从轨迹学习概率流速度，避免了对漂移项、扩散项和 score 的估计。作者的稳定性分析将离散化误差与采样方差分离，并表明：当时间分辨率与样本量适当平衡时，单步、无需仿真的 FTM 损失是稳定的。在多个随机动力系统与 PDE 示例中，FTM 以低成本的确定性 rollout 实现了具备轨迹感知能力的集成预测。
key_points_zh: 提出 First-Order Trajectory Matching（FTM），从轨迹中学习概率质量的一阶局部输运，用作随机、混沌、湍流系统的代理模型。
FTM 直接学习 probability current velocity，避免显式估计 drift、diffusion 或 score，降低建模复杂度。
方法不仅匹配时间边缘分布和集成平均，还能捕捉 fluxes、circulations、barrier-crossing currents 等轨迹相关物理量。
理论上给出稳定性分析，区分离散化误差与采样方差，说明在时间分辨率和样本量平衡时单步 FTM loss 稳定。
在随机动力系统和 PDE 实验中，FTM 以低成本确定性 rollout 实现快速、轨迹感知的 ensemble prediction。

llm_assessment.comment: Technically interesting for stochastic surrogate modeling, but largely outside agent harness evolution and production agent infrastructure.
llm_assessment.comment_zh: 该工作在随机系统代理建模上有技术兴趣，但基本不属于智能体框架演进或生产级基础设施方向。
